name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: R1, RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key), is not stated by the task. “If you move the ball, you must also take the key” requires the key after the ball is moved, so use hard Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key), not a rule that allows the key to come first. Keep the hard Precedence and Existence clauses for picking up the box.

CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key) weakens “If you move the ball, you must also take the key.” It allows the key to be acquired later, whereas “also” gives no timing and the key may come before the ball. Use hard RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key). Keep the hard Precedence and Existence for picking up the box after acquiring the key.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) requires the box, and Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) captures “Then pick up the box” after taking the key. The first clause matches “If you move the ball, you must also take the key” and is not an unrequested clause; keep it even though the other hard clauses imply it.

texts: If the ball is moved, the matching key must also be acquired at some point, before or after the ball is moved.
Pick up the mission's box after acquiring the matching key.
Pick up the mission's box in the other room.
